data.name: DELVERS
data.detailed_description:
Dive with up to four players into the Depths, an endless network of shifting dungeons hidden far below the surface. Every expedition is a high-stakes run for treasure, magic, and survival. Go deeper for better rewards, but face greater danger with every step.

DELVERS is a first person PvE co-op adventure set in a dark fantasy world with a distinct retro pixelated visual style, featuring procedurally generated dungeons that reshape themselves every time you enter. Explore twisting hallways, discover valuable artifacts, unlock temporary spells, and use what you find to stay alive long enough to escape.

You are indebted to the Goblin Guild, a cunning and ruthless faction that owns your every breath. To pay off your debt, you must delve into the Depths and bring back valuables. In return, the goblins upgrade your gear and your descent capabilities — but every improvement only sinks you deeper into what you owe. Stronger upgrades mean access to deeper layers and richer loot, yet the Guild always demands more.

Communication is essential.
Use 3D positional voice chat to coordinate, warn allies of traps, call for help, or navigate the darkness together. Stick as a group for safety or split up to cover more ground and chase more loot, but every choice increases the risk.

Survive, upgrade, and descend again.
